author: Matt Wolfe
description:
A powerful open-source AI agent sounds cool, but running it yourself can get risky fast.

OpenClaw (aka MoltBot/Clawdbot) runs directly on your machine, meaning it has access to your files, environment variables, and system. That’s why so many people were excited and nervous at the same time.

The safer move is to self-host it on a VPS.

With Hostinger, you can run OpenClaw completely isolated from your personal computer, behind proper cloud security, and you don’t have to manually set anything up. Their one-click Docker template deploys it for you in minutes.

Head to hostinger.com/mw10 and use the coupon code MATTWOLFE to try out Clawdbot/MoltBot/OpenClaw easier and more securely.
